budget_origin: Pre-run initial exposure v2: 262144 joint steps rounded up to whole rollout; not convergence or success criterion
selection_basis: All native actions categorical. Per-role native returns; no assumed shared team reward. Parameter sharing with explicit role index permits different role policies and bounds memory at up to 768 roles. Local observations only, no privileged critic.
memory_limit: Four local frames, feedforward; partial observation can require recurrent follow-up, not claimed sufficient.

task.objective: Complete all four receivers' ordered three-colour demands using the finite 8-blue/8-amber source.
task.natural_termination: Success when every receiver progress is 3; natural failure when both source stocks are empty and all pulses absorbed with work remaining. Natural completion precedes the 512-step limit.
task.interaction: Technicians must be orthogonally adjacent to operate physical fixtures. Pulses advance along the rail tree using old turnout states, are consumed by arrivals, and reveal the next local demand only after a match.
task.observation_access: Only Chebyshev-radius-2 local cells and current local receiver demand are observed, plus own identity/position and time. Map/entity visibility arrays match this access. Full recipes, remote state and debug events remain privileged; scene rendering adds no policy inputs.

native_event_definitions.meaning: 0=wait, 1=walk accepted, 2=walk rejected, 3=set accepted, 4=set conflict, 5=launch accepted, 6=launch rejected, 7=set rejected.
True for out-of-range input IDs replaced by WAIT.
True when adjacent technicians issued both conflicting SET values in this transition.
True when eligible nearby source requesters requested both colours, producing no launch.
Mask of this transition's actual pulse events.
0=none, 1=ordinary rail motion, 2=arrival accepted, 3=arrival wrong colour, 4=arrival at already-complete receiver, 5=new launch.
Old node index; -1 for a launch or inactive event.
Actual destination node, including a receiver for consumed pulses; source node 0 for a launch; -1 for inactive event.
Colour of the event pulse; -1 for inactive event.
Unique launch identity of this event pulse; -1 when inactive.
Storage slot associated with the event, allowing an old consumed pulse and a newly launched pulse to reuse a slot without sharing an identity.
0 unless this transition ends the episode, then the corresponding new terminal_reason.
Total actual source launches, never decreases.

primary_metric: mean across roles of unmodified native episode returns; inspect role vector and task events, mean can cancel in competitive games
evaluation_policy: stochastic legal-action sampling; same independent seeds and native horizon for random/IPPO
selection_rule: No selection by evaluation; initial final checkpoint reported, every intermediate point retained
stop_rule: Complete frozen joint-step exposure. Stop safely for nonfinite values, native contract error, resource limit, or explicit coordinator/user instruction. Wall slices resume same identity.
scope: Existing Crucibles games only; does not implement original LLM/UED/meta-gradient experiment
